name: Micron Corporation
old_description: High-Mix, Low-Volume Specialists. PCB Assemblies on either a turnkey or consignment basis. New England Electronic Manufacturing Services since 1982. Prototypes, NPI, and Production Builds to IPC-A-610 / J-STD-001.
about:
Micron Corporation has operated from Norwood, Massachusetts since 1982. Founded as a small shop serving local OEMs with precision electronics manufacturing, the company remains family owned and operated, with decisions made close to the shop floor and a focus on long-term customer relationships.

Today Micron provides electronic manufacturing services spanning SMT assembly (including fine-pitch, QFN/BGA, and 01005 placement on a MYCRONIC MY300 line), through-hole and mixed-technology assembly, box build and electromechanical integration, cable and harness assembly, conformal coating and potting, selective soldering, and rework to IPC standards. The shop supports prototypes, new product introductions, and recurring high-mix, low-volume production runs, with inspection capabilities that include 3D AOI and X-ray verification for hidden solder joints. Workmanship follows IPC-A-610 and J-STD-001 Class 2 or 3 as specified.

The company serves OEMs in medical and life sciences, aerospace and defense (ITAR-registered), energy and cleantech, automotive aftermarket, industrial automation, and research and development. Micron also manufactures its own consumer products, the RODAR® II ultrasonic pest repeller and EnergAire® ionizer air purifier, leveraging the same EMS expertise.

Micron emphasizes responsive communication, high-mix flexibility, and a partnership mindset that aims to act as an extension of the customer's team. The family ownership structure enables direct access to project managers and quick decision-making, while documented quality practices, traceability, and supply chain support (turnkey, consignment, or hybrid) help reduce risk on complex assemblies.
